title: Electric Meadow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The city hums a tune I almost know
We chased the daylight down the coast

[Chorus]
Hold the night, don't let it go
Whisper secrets to the open sky

[Verse 2]
We chased the daylight down the coast
The city hums a tune I almost know

[Chorus]
Hold the night, don't let it go
Whisper secrets to the open sky

[Outro]
And the song goes on and on
structure: Intro (4 bars) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Bridge (8) / Chorus (16) / Outro (4)
desc: A dreamy jazz song at 70 BPM in B minor, written by the Signature song engine.
